definitions.Orthopnea: Shortness of breath that occurs when lying flat, causing the person to have to sleep propped up in bed or sitting in a chair.
definitions.Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea: Attacks of severe shortness of breath and coughing that generally occur at night, usually awakening the person from sleep.
definitions.Pernicious anaemia: A type of megaloblastic anemia caused by the body's inability to absorb vitamin B12 due to a lack of intrinsic factor.
definitions.Macula densa: An area of closely packed specialized cells lining the wall of the distal tubule that monitors the sodium chloride concentration of the tubular fluid.
definitions.Glomerular filtration rate: The volume of fluid filtered from the renal glomerular capillaries into Bowman's capsule per unit time.
definitions.Isovolumetric contraction: The early phase of ventricular systole when the ventricles contract with no corresponding volume change because all heart valves are closed.
definitions.Surfactant: A surface-active lipoprotein complex formed by type II alveolar cells that reduces surface tension in the alveoli, preventing their collapse.
definitions.Chemoreceptor: A sensory cell or organ responsive to chemical stimuli, such as changes in the concentration of carbon dioxide, oxygen, or hydrogen ions.
definitions.Ptyalin: A form of amylase found in the saliva of humans and some other animals that catalyzes the hydrolysis of starch into maltose and dextrin.

questions.stem: Water permeability of the collecting duct is primarily regulated by:
questions.explanation: Antidiuretic hormone (ADH, or vasopressin) regulates water permeability in the late distal tubule and collecting duct by stimulating the insertion of aquaporin-2 channels into the apical membrane (Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology).
Ammonia (NH3) binds to secreted hydrogen ions (H+) to form ammonium (NH4+), acting as a crucial urinary buffer.
